newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar mostly higher after NY July expiry.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar mostly higher after NY July expiry.

text.p: LIFFE sugar was mostly higher in Tuesday morning trading.
By 1025 GMT August was $1.30 higher at $322.50, while October, most active month with 134 of 330 lots done so far, was $1.20 higher at $317.50.
There was some trade buying in the market, one trader said. "Perhaps its a reflection of the July New York expiry, which may be construed as a little bit more friendly than expected," he said.
A total of 1,156 lots of raw sugar, equivalent to 57,800 long tons, was delivered against the New York July contract, European trade sources said on Tuesday.
New York sugar futures closed higher on Monday in a volatile session.
